subject: SOC 2 re-attestation & retention change for renewal
messages:
From: Amira Thompson <amira@novuscloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 re-attestation & retention change for renewal

Hi Karthik / Lauren,

We’re kicking off our renewal process for Novus Cloud (renewal date 2025-07-31) and have two requests tied to the security re-attestation:

1) We need the updated SOC 2 report + evidence manifest for the past 12 months (rather than the 90-day snapshot we had previously). Can Redwood provide the attestation artifacts and a named-point contact for the evidence handoff?

2) We’re evaluating increasing our log retention to 365 days for a subset of endpoints (primarily auth and API access logs). Please send a cost estimate and confirmation on how those logs are stored/archived (hosted vs escrow) and whether retention changes will impact our committed throughput pricing.

Timeline: we need a mutual action plan and evidence handoff window scheduled no later than 2025-07-15 to satisfy our audit committee.

I’ve attached a short checklist of required items (evidence_manifest.csv).

Thanks,
Amira Thompson
Director, Compliance & Risk
Novus Cloud

--
Attachment: evidence_manifest.csv (CSV stub, 8 rows)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Amira Thompson <amira@novuscloud.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation & retention change for renewal

Hi Amira — thanks for the clear ask.

We can support a 365-day retention for the specified endpoints. To make this smooth and keep your app latency/costs predictable, propose the following short plan:

- MAP (mutual action plan) drafted and shared by EOD today (attached: MAP-draft.docx).
- Evidence handoff window: Redwood will prepare a compressed evidence bundle (SOC 2 report, control mapping, snapshots of access logs) and provide a secure transfer link. Proposed staging window: 2025-07-06 to 2025-07-10.
- Retention pricing: incremental storage + ingestion charge — preliminary estimate attached (retention-cost-estimate.xlsx). We’ll provide a firm number after we confirm the log volume slice for the auth/API endpoints.
- Throughput/commitment: If Novus increases retention to 365 days and adds a 20% throughput uplift (per your note on capacity), we recommend moving to a dedicated capacity commit for that slice — I’ve listed options in the MAP.

Action items for Novus:
- Please confirm which endpoints are in scope (auth, api-access, and any others).
- Confirm acceptance of staging window 2025-07-06—07-10.

I’ve cc’d Kimberly to flag billing/contract tweaks and Lauren to coordinate the renewal signature path.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0212

Attachments: MAP-draft.docx (Word stub), retention-cost-estimate.xlsx (Excel stub)

From: Amira Thompson <amira@novuscloud.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Novus Cloud Compliance <security@novuscloud.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 11:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation & retention change for renewal

Karthik — this looks good.

Confirming: auth + api-access endpoints only. Staging window 2025-07-06—07-10 works for our audit team.

A few clarifying Qs:
- For the evidence bundle, we need named hashes for each artifact and an MD5/SHA checksum on the transfer. Can Redwood include those?
- For retention storage: does Redwood retain logs in-region (US-East) or will archival go to a central bucket (we prefer regionally-resident storage).
- If we move to dedicated capacity for that slice, will the minimum commit term match our renewal (12 months) or can we align to a shorter commitment for the retention-only slice?

Attaching our compliance questionnaire — it has a couple of additional items about key rotation and KMS integrations (security-questionnaire.pdf).

Thanks for the quick turnaround.
Amira

--
Attachment: security-questionnaire.pdf (PDF stub, 12 pages)

Amira — great, we’ll lock this in.

Quick summary and next steps:
- Novus scope confirmed: auth + api-access endpoints; retention = 365 days.
- Evidence handoff: Redwood will provide the SHA256 checksums in the transfer manifest; staging window 2025-07-06—07-10.
- Storage residency: we will place the archival logs in US-East (single-region residency) unless you request multi-region copy (that would change costs).
- Dedicated capacity commit: we can offer a 6-month carveout for the retention-only slice that aligns to your audit window; to lock the discounted rate we need signature on a short amendment (see DocuSign link). Full 12-month commit available if you prefer predictable pricing for the year.

Pricing & paperwork: Kimberly will follow up with a final amendment and the updated order form. I’ve created a HubSpot deal record and the DocuSign envelope — links below. If you’re good with the 6-month carveout we’ll issue an amendment and route for signature today so engineering can stage the evidence export.
